description: Send one typed edit to your approved After Effects composition for review. Kinds: project.save, comp.new, comp.settings, media.import, layer.text, layer.solid, layer.footage, layer.precomp, layer.time, layer.order, layer.remove, property.set, property.keyframes, expression.set, effect.add, preset.apply, layer.audio, render.queue, render.run, render.still, mogrt.export. Layers are named by their snapshot key; properties by alias (position, scale, rotation, opacity, anchor, sourceText) or an ADBE match name path. media.import takes asset (an id from list_my_assets, list_my_videos or list_my_audio) or url (a Switch link); the panel downloads it next to the project and imports it with no dialog, and at (a frame) also adds it to the composition as a layer. effect.add takes the effect menu name or ADBE match name plus params by property name; preset.apply names an installed animation preset; layer.audio adds a sound item from the project with its level in dB. batch.run carries up to twenty single edits that run in order as one undo step. When the snapshot says alwaysAllow, the panel runs the edit without a click. Times are whole composition frames; read frameRate and durationFrames first. Supply projectId, compId and revision from a fresh read. One operation per request; use the same requestId for retries. Queued does not mean edited: only a done status means After Effects reported a verified readback. Nothing is charged.
name: aftereffects_request_edit
title: Aftereffects Request Edit
